设计意图： Captures persistence in volume trend: a rising short-term EMA relative to long-term EMA indicates increasing volume momentum, which may precede persistent price moves. This is a volume-based persistence signal aligned to temporal stability within the Stability & Regime-Gating layer.

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 vol：volume
  2. 计算 ema_short：talib.EMA(vol, timeperiod=10)
  3. 计算 ema_long：talib.EMA(vol, timeperiod=30)
  4. 计算 factor：ema_short / ema_long
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_trend_consistency(df): df_copy = df.copy() vol = df_copy["volume"] ema_short = talib.EMA(vol, timeperiod=10) ema_long = talib.EMA(vol, timeperiod=30) factor = ema_short / ema_long.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_volume_trend_consistency"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_volume_trend_consistency"]
